numeric_identity.definition: M1: same row_fnv1a64 for every step (= bit-identical logits)

decision_agreement.definition: M2: same argmax_token for every step (= same chosen token)

topk_set_agreement.definition: M3: same top-N token id set (= same candidate set)

cross_tab_note: num_eq_dec_eq = no drift, same choice | num_eq_dec_ne = impossible without a tie-break bug | num_ne_dec_eq = drift but same choice (M1 says 'differs', M2 says 'identical') | num_ne_dec_ne = real divergence
